approaches.title: Manual bit-by-bit reversal
approaches.summary: Iterates over all 32 bits, shifting the result and appending the current least-significant bit from the input.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Introduces a 32-iteration loop that reverses the bits using shifts, masking, and accumulation.
Combines the result shift and extracted-bit operation into a single expression without changing the algorithm.

approaches.title: Built-in bit reversal
approaches.summary: Uses Rust’s built-in integer bit-reversal method to reverse all bits directly.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaces the manual loop with the standard library’s `reverse_bits` method.
